newsitem.title: USA: NIMO to shut 610 MW NY power plant Friday.
newsitem.headline: NIMO to shut 610 MW NY power plant Friday.

text.p: The Nuclear Regulatory Commission (NRC) said Friday that Niagara Mohawk Power Corp plans to shut its 610 megawatt (MW) Nine Mile Point nuclear power plant later today for repairs.
Shutdown of the generating unit, in Scriba, N.Y., was expected to last over the weekend, an NRC spokesman said.
"(It) will shut later today to fix a drywell leak," he said.
The adjoining 1,137 MW Nine Mile Point unit 2 would continue to run at full output during unit 1's shutdown, the spokesman said.
NIMO operates both Nine Mile Point units. The company wholly owns unit 1 and has 41 percent of unit 2.
Nine Mile Point 2 is also owned by New York State Gas and Electric Co, Long Island Lighting Co, Rochester Gas and Electric and Central Hudson Gas and Electric .
